I've successfully added two methods to the `Ledger` class in `ledger/entries.py`:

1. **`post_end_of_day(account, amount, day: date) -> Entry`** — Posts an entry at 23:59:59 UTC of the specified date by composing a datetime with the given date and the end-of-day time (23:59:59) in UTC timezone, then delegating to the existing `post()` method.

2. **`entries_since(since: datetime) -> list[Entry]`** — Filters entries posted at or after the given timestamp and returns them sorted by `posted_at` in chronological order (oldest/earliest timestamp first).

Both methods respect the existing time rule (UTC timezone-aware datetimes) and all 10 existing tests pass.
